questions.stem: A circle has a circumference of $18\pi\text{ cm}$. What is its diameter?
A semicircular shape has a diameter of $10\text{ cm}$. What is the total perimeter of the semicircle? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: The curved part is half the circumference: $\frac{1}{2} \times \pi \times 10 = 5\pi\text{ cm}$. The straight edge is the diameter $= 10\text{ cm}$. Total perimeter $= 5\pi + 10\text{ cm}$.

questions.stem: A wheel has a radius of $30\text{ cm}$. How far does it travel in one complete revolution? Give your answer in terms of $\pi$.
questions.explanation: In one revolution, the wheel travels a distance equal to its circumference: $C = 2\pi r = 2 \times \pi \times 30 = 60\pi\text{ cm}$.
